name: Eon
abilities: Chronokinesis - control of the flow of time around him or a target
Time rays that rapidly age targets (even to dust)
Dynakinesis - energy control and force fields
weaknesses: Eon's own personality overrides Ben's if the Omnitrix failsafe is off
Repeated time-leaps weaken and pale the body
Time rays are useless against Petrosapiens
summary: The alternate-timeline Ben's darkest form: a purple-energy Chronian time-manipulator forced into the Omnitrix by Eon himself, who then seized Ben's mind.
traits: Only appears in the live-action Ben 10: Race Against Time
Never used by Ben Prime on-screen (Race Against Time timeline only)
Omnitrix turned violet when Eon's DNA was added
Second form after Ghostfreak to suppress Ben's personality
notableFeats: Activated the Hands of Armageddon while under Eon's control (Ben 10: Race Against Time)
Broke free of chains and resisted Diamondhead's shards / Heatblast's fire (as the original Eon)

appearances.designNotes: Live-action: looks like Eon without the helmet, with pale white skin and bags under the eyes; purple time-energy; Omnitrix on the right side of the stomach. ALTERNATE TIMELINE (Race Against Time).

image.label: OS
image.notes: Only infobox image (unlabelled); live-action still of Ben-as-Eon from Race Against Time.

scoring.rationale: Time rays that age enemies to dust, force fields, illusions and telekinesis give him a fight-ending kit and real time/space manipulation. Ineffective on Petrosapiens, and the form's donor personality took Ben over - Ben effectively could not control it.

notes: ALTERNATE TIMELINE: exists only in Ben 10: Race Against Time; the movie was originally canon to the prime timeline as of AF season 1 but is now its own timeline. Ben Prime never used Eon.
The wiki's 'Eon.wikitext' cache is the villain page; the transformation page is 'Eon (Transformation)'.
Immediately locked after Ben reverted; one of only two regular transformations (with Spitter) never used by Ben Prime on-screen.
